scope.objective: Adversarial threat model for external witness, trust, source/G2/environment provenance and local discovery closure.
scope.r2_work_packages: Unfinished packages are referenced only by their declared interface and are not presumed complete.
scope.credit_rule: A passing static check, local hash, runner exit, receipt, or review can describe preparation only; it cannot mint external authority, UP1, B00/B04, R01-R10, or L4 credit.

decision_semantics.fail_closed: Use for a detected contradiction, forgery, mutation, ambiguity, replay, unsupported algorithm, or policy violation. Reject and do not publish.
decision_semantics.terminal_deferred: Use only when the required external fact or service is unavailable or typed_absent and no contradiction was established. Preserve the absence and do not publish.
decision_semantics.typed_absence: A typed absence is an explicit missing input with owner, authoritative source, recovery condition and expiry/revocation semantics; it is never pass, valid, trusted, good, or accepted authority.
decision_semantics.program_exception: An unexpected tool/runtime/process fault is an independently recorded evidence state. It is not fail_closed and not typed_absence/terminal_deferred; the review protocol must classify the package as rework or block_external after preserving raw evidence, and it can never be promoted to pass.
decision_semantics.safe_retry: Only identical bytes with identical idempotency key may return the prior result. Any material input or scope change needs a new bounded attempt and fingerprint.

component_interfaces.interface: independent attestor identity/independence, signed attestation, authority endpoint, request/ack and candidate G1/G2/G3/four-axis binding
canonical receipt, root/intermediate/leaf chain, signature profile, revocation, trusted time and nonce/sequence/idempotency replay ledger
candidate-bound source inventory, authoritative G2 mapping, import/environment closure, binary provenance and SBOM/license closure
one-to-one discovery/crosswalk and explicit exclusion inventory; local or historical records remain non-authoritative
R2 environment provenance interface, if/when present
independent review and receipt interface, if/when present
candidate identity and G1/G2/G3 plus four-axis lineage consumed by every external receipt
component_interfaces.current_state: must be recomputed and independently bound

threats.title: Attestor or authority identity impersonation
threats.attacker_goal: Make a source author, local process, or fixture appear to be the independent attestor/authority.
threats.attack_test: replace identity, certificate, issuer or independence record with self-authored/TEST_ONLY value
threats.detect: independent identity registry, chain-to-pinned-root, EKU/policy, conflict boundary and signature verification

threats.title: Candidate substitution
threats.attacker_goal: Reuse a valid-looking receipt from candidate A for candidate B.
threats.attack_test: change candidate reference while retaining signed source/evidence bytes
threats.detect: bidirectional candidate/evidence edges and recomputed canonical digest

threats.title: Source path or revision substitution
threats.attacker_goal: Present a different source tree, dirty executor, HEAD or patch as the attested source.
threats.attack_test: swap HEAD/working-tree hash, path, or AD56 dirty executor after receipt creation
threats.detect: recompute bytes/OIDs and compare signed source inventory; distinguish HEAD from dirty executor

threats.title: G1/G2/G3 or four-axis cross-wiring
threats.attacker_goal: Use one layer/axis declaration with another candidate, source or evidence edge.
threats.attack_test: replace one axis or layer identifier while leaving other hashes unchanged
threats.detect: exact four-axis inventory, no implicit defaults, bidirectional edge equality and scope check

threats.title: Trust-chain/root substitution
threats.attacker_goal: Replace a pinned root, intermediate, leaf, issuer or policy with a locally trusted chain.
threats.attack_test: replace root or chain, use source-author self-signature, or use TEST_ONLY root as production anchor
threats.detect: pin root out-of-band, validate path in declared order, reject unknown critical extensions and test roots

threats.title: Signature/canonicalization algorithm downgrade
threats.attacker_goal: Accept a weak, unknown, retired or placeholder digest/signature/profile.
threats.attack_test: change profile to null, placeholder, legacy weak algorithm, or TEST_ONLY OID in production
threats.detect: versioned profile registry and strict algorithm/encoding/key-strength allowlist

threats.description_zh: 撤销源失联或响应陈旧
threats.title: Revocation source unavailable or stale
threats.attacker_goal: Treat unavailable/expired/unknown CRL or OCSP as good forever.
threats.attack_test: remove revocation source, expire response, mismatch issuer/serial, or return unknown
threats.detect: verify response signature, issuer/serial binding, freshness and as-of semantics

threats.title: Trusted-time rollback or future-time injection
threats.attacker_goal: Make an expired/revoked receipt appear current using OS clock, mtime, Git time or altered genTime.
threats.attack_test: rollback local clock, alter mtime/log time, or use timestamp for another digest
threats.detect: independent signed RFC3161/equivalent token, imprint and validity checks; OS time is observation only

threats.title: Nonce/challenge replay
threats.attacker_goal: Reuse a consumed nonce or challenge in the same or foreign scope.
threats.attack_test: submit duplicate nonce, cross-scope nonce, or old nonce
threats.detect: durable replay ledger with scope and trusted-time window

threats.title: Sequence rollback or gap hiding
threats.attacker_goal: Reorder old receipts or hide a missing sequence by presenting a lower/reused sequence.
threats.attack_test: decrease sequence, reuse sequence under another scope, or submit out of order
threats.detect: monotone per-scope ledger and explicit gap/rollback policy

threats.title: Idempotency-key replay or conflict
threats.attacker_goal: Cause a second authority action or make changed content look like a safe retry.
threats.attack_test: reuse key with changed bytes/scope or repeat after retention expiry
threats.detect: key-to-digest ledger; identical bytes return prior result only; changed bytes conflict

threats.title: Check/use race on files or manifests
threats.attacker_goal: Pass hash/check at validation time then replace file before signature, import or execution.
threats.attack_test: mutate or replace file between discovery, hashing, validation and use
threats.detect: open-and-hash same immutable bytes, snapshot/descriptor identity, re-hash immediately before use

threats.title: Symlink, junction or path-traversal escape
threats.attacker_goal: Make a permitted path resolve outside the declared root or to an attacker-controlled target.
threats.attack_test: use .., alternate separators, symlink/junction/reparse point or case collision
threats.detect: canonicalize without following untrusted links, enforce root containment and reject reparse/symlink components

threats.title: Manifest self-reference, omission, mismatch or extra
threats.attacker_goal: Make an incomplete or mutable manifest appear hash-complete by hashing itself or excluding owned files ambiguously.
threats.attack_test: self-reference, omit an owned artifact, mismatch an artifact hash, or add an unlisted extra file
threats.detect: acyclic preimage rule, exact-set check, explicit exclusions and independent recomputation

threats.title: Duplicate key, numeric or canonical JSON ambiguity
threats.attacker_goal: Exploit parser disagreement so signed bytes and interpreted fields differ.
threats.attack_test: duplicate candidate/source key, NaN/Infinity, alternate number form, invalid UTF-8 or unknown field
threats.detect: strict parser with duplicate rejection, deterministic canonicalization and byte-for-byte digest comparison

threats.title: SBOM/dependency omission
threats.attacker_goal: Hide a runtime, package, transitive dependency, license or imported artifact from the closure.
threats.attack_test: remove transitive package, imported module, artifact or license from SBOM/manifest
threats.detect: reproduce imports in a clean process, compare lock/import/artifact/SBOM sets and require candidate-bound signed closure

threats.title: Binary substitution or unsigned executable
threats.attacker_goal: Run a different binary than the one named by version, publisher, origin or build recipe.
threats.attack_test: replace executable, alter PATH, use unsigned cache, or provide self-reported version only
threats.detect: hash opened binary, verify publisher/signature/origin/build recipe and bind to candidate/environment manifest

threats.title: Environment drift
threats.attacker_goal: Replay a receipt under a different OS, architecture, runtime, package lock, locale, timezone or variable set.
threats.attack_test: change runtime/package/locale/timezone or PATH after capture
threats.detect: candidate-bound environment digest and independent clean-process replay; no inferred defaults

threats.title: typed_absence incorrectly treated as pass
threats.attacker_goal: Turn missing owner/source/signature/time/revocation/SBOM data into accepted authority or a green status.
threats.attack_test: replace typed_absence with null/empty/true, treat local hash or runner exit as present, or map unavailable to good
threats.detect: closed state enum and negative fixtures; promotion requires every required external field and independent evidence

threats.title: Canonical receipt or scope mutation
threats.attacker_goal: Change bytes, scope, source version or evidence after signing while retaining a stale digest/signature.
threats.attack_test: mutate any signed field, reorder/whitespace JSON, or attach foreign evidence
threats.detect: canonicalize exact bytes first, compare digest, then verify signature and all edges

global_acceptance_invariants: Every attack row has an impacted component, detection oracle, explicit fail_closed or typed_absence -> terminal_deferred mapping and no_publish=true.
Contradiction is never downgraded to deferred; unavailable external evidence is never upgraded to pass.
All candidate/source/G1/G2/G3/four-axis identifiers and hashes are signed or otherwise independently bound before authority decisions.
Raw inputs, failed attempts, PID, UTC, exit code and SHA-256 receipts are retained; failure artifacts are not deleted or silently replaced.
No local preparation, test fixture, historical AD55/AD56 record, source hash, environment observation or runner exit grants external credit.
